tool.name: krepp index
tool.description: build a reference index for k-mer based distance estimation
tool.command:
mkdir -p refs && #for $ref in $ref_genomes: ln -s '$ref' 'refs/${ref.element_identifier}' && #end for #for $ref in $ref_genomes: echo '${ref.element_identifier}\trefs/${ref.element_identifier}' >> input_map.tsv && #end for
krepp index -i input_map.tsv -o index_out -k $kmer_size -h $hamming_dist -w $window_size -m $num_partitions -r $partition #if $frac_mode: --frac #else: --no-frac #end if #if $nwk_tree: -t '$nwk_tree' #end if --num-threads \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-4} && tar -cf '$index_archive' -C index_out .

param.name: ref_genomes
param.label: Reference genomes
param.help: FASTA files containing reference genome sequences. Dataset names will be used as reference IDs and must match tip labels in the backbone tree if provided.

param.name: nwk_tree
param.label: Backbone tree (optional)
param.help: Newick-format phylogenetic tree whose tip labels match reference dataset names

param.name: kmer_size
param.label: K-mer size
param.help: Size of k-mers to use for indexing

param.name: hamming_dist
param.label: Hamming distance threshold
param.help: Maximum Hamming distance for k-mer matching

param.name: partition
param.label: Partition index
param.help: Which partition to build (1-indexed). Build all partitions sequentially for a complete index.

param.name: frac_mode
param.label: Use FracMinHash mode
param.help: Enable or disable FracMinHash sketching. Enabled by default.

tool.help:
**What it does**
Builds a krepp reference index from a set of reference genomes. The index uses LSH (Locality-Sensitive Hashing) with colored k-mers and FracMinHash sketching to enable fast distance estimation and phylogenetic placement of query sequences.
**Inputs**
- **Reference genomes**: One or more FASTA files containing reference genome sequences. The dataset names are used as reference IDs in the output and must match tip labels in the backbone tree if one is provided. - **Backbone tree** (optional): A Newick-format phylogenetic tree whose tip labels match the reference dataset names. If provided, the tree is embedded in the index for later phylogenetic placement.
**Output**
A tar archive containing the krepp index directory. This archive can be used directly as input to `krepp dist` and `krepp place`.
**Parameters**
- **K-mer size**: Length of k-mers extracted from reference genomes. Larger values increase specificity but reduce sensitivity. - **Hamming distance threshold**: Maximum allowed Hamming distance between k-mers for them to be considered matching. - **Minimizer window size**: Window size for minimizer selection; affects sketch density. - **Number of partitions**: Number of FracMinHash partitions for the index. - **Partition index**: Which partition to build (1-indexed). Build all partitions sequentially for a complete index. - **FracMinHash mode**: Enable/disable FracMinHash sketching.
**Memory note**
Memory usage increases linearly with the number of threads. Consider using fewer threads for large reference sets.
